data.task_title: Create Artemis self-demo with Chart.js visualization

features.title: Real-Time Metrics Dashboard
features.description: Showcase real-time metrics using Chart.js graphs in the demo.
acceptance_criteria: Live metrics are updated in real-time
Graphs accurately reflect LLM cost over time, stage completion rates, and success rate trends
Data is presented clearly and is easy to interpret

features.title: Chart.js Visualizations
features.description: Use Chart.js to create various data visualizations for the Artemis demo.
acceptance_criteria: Pipeline metrics are displayed using a line chart
Cost tracking is visualized with a bar chart
Success rates are shown using an area chart
Supervisor integration is depicted with a pie chart
Code quality metrics are represented using a radar chart

features.title: Integration with Existing Demos
features.description: Use existing demo templates as a foundation for the new presentation.
acceptance_criteria: Incorporate elements from contract_analytics_dashboard.html
Incorporate elements from lead_opportunity_intelligence_demo.html
Incorporate elements from artemis_complete_demo.html

features.title: Standalone HTML Presentation
features.description: Create a single HTML file with embedded CSS, JavaScript, and Chart.js for the Artemis demo.
acceptance_criteria: HTML file includes all necessary CSS and JavaScript within itself
Chart.js library is embedded and functional
File is self-contained and does not rely on external resources

features.title: Auto-Advance and Navigation Controls
features.description: Implement auto-advance functionality with navigation controls for the presentation.
acceptance_criteria: Slides auto-advance after a set duration
Users can manually navigate between slides
Navigation controls are intuitive and responsive

features.title: Professional Design and Transitions
features.description: Incorporate a professional gradient background and smooth transitions in the presentation.
acceptance_criteria: Background uses a gradient design
Slide transitions are smooth and visually appealing
Design elements are consistent with a professional theme
